notes.title: Notice of Postponement of "VR-Kanojo" Release
notes.content:
hank you very much for your continued interest in VR-Kanojo.

Originally scheduled for release on April 24, 2025, we have decided to postpone the launch to further improve the quality of the game.

Following the release of our promotional video on April 3, we received a wide range of valuable feedback from the community. Many of the comments highlighted concerns regarding the visuals of the main heroine, Sakura Yuuhi, as well as the overall graphical presentation.

After careful internal discussions, we have concluded that additional development time is needed to meet expectations and deliver a higher-quality experience.

We are currently targeting a release in Summer 2025. A finalized release date will be announced once development progresses further.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the game, and appreciate your understanding and continued support.

We are working hard to ensure that VR-Kanojo will be worth the wait.

notes.title: [Notice of Postponement] Change to Late April Release Schedule and Current Statu
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your continued support of our “VR Kanojo.”
We have an important announcement to share with everyone today.

As previously stated, we aimed to release the product in February, but despite making multiple revisions and resubmissions for Steam approval, we have yet to obtain official permission for distribution. In order to ensure a more reliable release on Steam and provide a game that everyone can enjoy with peace of mind, we have decided to implement a major overhaul, which necessitates additional development time.

Therefore, with sincere regret, we must postpone the release to late April. This marks our second postponement, and we deeply apologize for any inconvenience and concern this may cause to those who have been eagerly awaiting the release.

However, we firmly believe that by taking this extra time, we can deliver a more polished and compelling experience that will not disappoint your expectations. Our development team is working tirelessly every day to create a title that will make you feel, “I’m glad I waited.”

Please note that, depending on the status of Steam’s review, the release schedule may change again in the future. We will promptly provide updates on the confirmed release date and development progress as more information becomes available. We kindly ask for your understanding and cooperation in this matter.

We will continue striving to create a game that meets everyone’s expectations, and we thank you for your ongoing support of “VR Kanojo.”

notes.title: Astonishing Speed Achieves Goal! 'VR-Kanojo' Crowdfunding Exceeds 2 Million Yen
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/e091b2aa86a7b61ed9ee169d7374a11da1e119f0.png[/img]

The [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/756138/view]crowdfunding campaign[/url] for the next-generation VR game "VR-Kanojo," which started at 19:00 on September 2nd, exceeded its goal of 2 million yen in an astonishingly short time of just 1 hour and 40 minutes after launch!

"VR-Kanojo" is a brand-new VR entertainment experience developed with the aim of challenging the limits of VR technology and delivering unprecedented immersion and emotion. By utilizing the latest modeling techniques and shader development, it creates a realistic experience that feels as if you are spending time with a real girlfriend.

This incredibly fast achievement is all thanks to the support of everyone who contributed, and the entire team is filled with gratitude. Therefore, we have set new next goals to aim for further content additions! With each new goal reached, a new outfit for the heroine "Sakura Yuuhi" in "VR-Kanojo" will be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/5a506615219d16acabd497584e26505c044d23a4.png[/img]

[b]Achieving 5 million yen (250%):[/b] Nurse Outfit unlocked!
[b]Achieving 6 million yen (300%):[/b] Bunny Suit unlocked!
[b]Achieving 8 million yen (400%):[/b] The "Virgin-Killer Sweater" will be added!

Each outfit is designed to provide players with even more excitement and satisfaction. The funds raised will be used for further technical development and content creation to deliver a more advanced VR experience to everyone.

The crowdfunding campaign continues, and we are still seeking your support. Please check out the project page for the latest progress and details!

Your enthusiastic support will help pave the way for the future of next-generation VR entertainment. We look forward to your continued support of "VR-Kanojo"!

[h2]Crowdfunding Overview[/h2]
[b]Period:[/b] September 2, 2024 – October 19, 2024
[b]Goal Amount:[/b] 2 million yen (Achieved, challenging the next goal)
[b]Platform:[/b] CAMPFIRE
[b]Project URL:[/b] [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/756138/view]https://camp-fire.jp/projects/756138/view[/url]

notes.title: A star-studded team assembles for the development of "VR-Kanojo"!
notes.content:
Four highly regarded new members in the industry have joined the development team of "VR-Kanojo".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/375a32c67880d9e585ec16dbb2cb3f80d2972332.png[/img]

The new members are Go Hasegawa (a.k.a Matsusaka Ushio), known as the main programmer of "3D Custom Girl", Genz, who excelled as a character modeler for "VR Kanojo" and now serves as a supervisor, Rei Takanami, the scenario writer known for the best-selling TRPG "Angel Quest", and environmental artist Rousoku. We are confident that with their extensive experience and expertise, "VR-Kanojo" will further evolve, delivering an innovative experience to players.

[h2]VR-Kanojo gets even more real![/h2]

With the participation of these star creators, the "VR-Kanojo" project advances to a new stage. We are confident that their expertise and extensive experience will significantly contribute to the improvement of the quality of this work.

Go Hasegawa's programming skills will enable more realistic and natural character control in VR space, greatly enhancing player immersion. With Genz's experienced supervision, consistency and quality across the entire project are ensured. Rei Takanami's scenarios will weave stories that deeply resonate with players, strengthening emotional connections with the characters. Rousoku's outstanding environment design will create a captivating and meticulously crafted world.

By bringing together these talents, "VR-Kanojo" is expected to transcend the realm of VR games, offering players new experiences and emotions. We will continue to challenge ourselves to bring innovation to the industry and open new horizons for VR entertainment with this powerful team.

[h2]Introduction of Participating Members[/h2]

[h3]Go Hasegawa a.k.a Matsusaka Ushio - Programmer[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/0367a241ea7f35ef2833bffe36553b19257d5cd9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/2099dc44a3672e6e540c52c460a60ccdced80560.png[/img][/url]

Biography: After working at several game development companies, he joined Square (now Square Enix). He was involved in the development of the real-time rendering demo using characters from "Final Fantasy VIII" at a pre-PlayStation 2 launch presentation. He later participated in the development of "Shadow Hearts" released by Aruze (now Universal Entertainment). He joined TechArts upon returning to his hometown, where he handled the programming of "3D Custom Girl" and related products alone. "3D Custom Girl" allows users to freely customize characters, and its rich features and intuitive operability have gained wide support. He also created the "Heavy Save Data" model distribution method, leading to over 100,000 MODs. He has been a freelancer since 2014.

Comment: "I never imagined working on this project in various ways (laughs). But there's nothing negative at all, and I'm enjoying the production. This will be my first VR title for general sale among the works I've handled, and I hope it turns out well by utilizing my experience."

X: [url=https://x.com/thasega]https://x.com/thasega[/url]

[h3]Genz - Supervisor[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/f0effda2421de800514022fc5fc7f8a77f14ecf9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/d5783c4b00ccbc78b810e969724a558b7d62fc95.png[/img][/url]
Biography: A veteran character modeler who worked at ILLUSION for 18 years, handling numerous innovative works. Known for his directorial debut "Ore ga Shujinkou" released in 2012, he achieved overwhelming success as the lead character artist and art director for "VR-Kanojo". This success led to him becoming a founding member of the IVR Studio specializing in VR content development, where he played a central role. Even after ILLUSION's dissolution, he has been actively involved in VR game development, consistently providing cutting-edge graphics at the industry's forefront. As a toon-style character modeler, he has created many noteworthy works, and his technical prowess and creativity are highly acclaimed both within and outside the industry.

Comment: "In the development of "VR-Kanojo", I participated as a supervisor. I helped maximize the enthusiasm and talent of this team, ensuring users enjoy experiences beyond their imagination. Being involved in this project was also very stimulating and a good experience for me."

[h3]Rei Takanami - Scenario Writer[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/19f4589085f7ebb79a3848b5de7e9acd2fd429f5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/6674f1c65277336e4d14523b334d6a7cdac24ce8.png[/img][/url]
Biography: A scenario writer active in the Japanese game industry for many years, also known as a novelist. Debuted in 1994 and gained attention with the adult TRPG "Angel Quest". "Angel Quest" is famous as the world's first adult TRPG. Subsequently, she honed her unique storytelling and character depiction skills through serializations in "PC Paradise" and numerous novel works. Her representative works include "X-GIRL" and "Angel Blade", which are also popular in Taiwan.

Comment: "I was in charge of writing Sakura-chan's lines. I was honored to work with Yunayuna-san, whose work I had been a fan of for a long time. Everyone, please enjoy the story till the end!"

Web: [url=http://www.lares.dti.ne.jp/~narumin/takanami.html]http://www.lares.dti.ne.jp/~narumin/takanami.html[/url]

[h3]Rousoku - Environment Artist[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/3121f71f84e9555f9d6e1f8f935f9ba34272faba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078030/4c91ed2430daf99f1599e97735cb046ac583d0a3.png[/img][/url]
Biography: An indie game developer and founder of the innovative brand "Moyashi Giken". He developed the popular game "Eliminator Kaede-san" solo, captivating many fans with his unique vision and technical prowess. Mastering almost all skills necessary for game development, such as programming, modeling, and animation, he created numerous tools. His diverse expressions using Maya's MEL and Houdini's VEX are highly regarded. Proficient in many programming languages, including C, C++, C#, Python, Java, MEL, and VEX. Known for his traditional hanten as a trademark, his unique style leaves a strong impact, much like his works. His creativity and technical skills continue to move beyond indie games, impressing many people.

Comment: "In VR, normal maps are useless, so I meticulously model even parts that normally wouldn't be, sparing no effort. Unlike traditional games, where the user's viewpoint is freely movable, I pay close attention to details in places that are usually invisible. Even areas like the back of the TV and the side of the air conditioner, which are typically overlooked, are detailed. Everywhere you look is filled with surprises and emotions, so please enjoy every corner."
